annotation.title_clean: Sustainable and Ethical AI-Driven Recognition in Robotics: Integrating ESG Analytics and Human–Robot Interaction
annotation.title_en: Sustainable and Ethical AI-Driven Recognition in Robotics: Integrating ESG Analytics and Human–Robot Interaction
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Mallouli, F.; Amouri, L.; Dakhlaoui, M.; Chaabane, N.; Gmach, I.; Hammami, I.; et al.
annotation.venue: International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications (IJACSA)
annotation.summary_en: Journal article proposing an ESG-aware evaluation framework for AI-driven robotic recognition, combining a review of recognition methods, ethical and sustainable architectures, and applications with a machine-learning experiment linking ESG scores to firm profitability. Random Forest performed best; Environmental and Governance dimensions were most influential.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes an ESG-aware evaluation framework complementing traditional performance metrics for robotics.
Random Forest achieved accuracy 0.89, F1 0.88, AUROC 0.93 predicting profitability from ESG plus financial data.
Environmental and Governance pillars are the most influential ESG predictors.
Advocates explainable AI, ethics hooks in layered robot architecture, and life-cycle assessment.
Recommends model compression, quantization and dynamic sensor activation to cut energy use.
